RecapScript.title: RecapScript
RecapScript.description: A generated Myanmar Movie Recap script with viral titles, opening hook, timestamped scenes, and outro saved by a creator.

sourceTitle.description: Title or clip label for the recap script (1-160 chars).

viralTitles.description: Three viral Myanmar recap titles (1-5 items).

scenes.description: Ordered list of timestamped scenes with timestamp, visualCue, and Burmese voiceover.

outro.description: Engaging Burmese outro with comment question.

estimatedDuration.description: Estimated voiceover or video duration label.

directorNotes.description: Optional creator notes or story hints.

favorite.description: Whether the creator starred this script.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and update.

UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Creator account profile tracking free 3-day (1 video/day) trial dates, Video Coins balance, and VIP tier status.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

trialStartDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD calendar start date of the 3-day free trial in Asia/Yangon time.

freeTrialDates.description: Distinct YYYY-MM-DD dates (max 3) on which the creator used their 1 free daily video.

vipExpiresAtMs.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when VIP expires (0 when NONE).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and update.

AppConfig.title: AppConfig
AppConfig.description: Global Admin-controlled pricing, KBZPay/WavePay payment phone numbers, and in-app update broadcast notice.

coinCostPerVideo.description: Video Coins deducted per script generation or AI video dub.

wavePayNumber.description: WavePay merchant phone number configured by Admin.

vipV1Price.description: VIP V1 (1 month) price in MMK (default 45000).

vipV2Price.description: VIP V2 (2 months) price in MMK (default 56000).

vipV3Price.description: VIP V3 (7 months) price in MMK (default 150000).

announcementActive.description: Whether the on-screen App Update announcement is currently active.

announcementTitle.description: Title of the in-app update message.

announcementMessage.description: Body of the in-app update broadcast shown to users.

PaymentRequest.title: PaymentRequest
PaymentRequest.description: User payment proof submission (KBZPay or WavePay) for VIP V1/V2/V3 or Video Coins awaiting Admin approval.

requestType.description: Whether user is purchasing a VIP plan or Video Coins.

vipTier.description: Requested VIP tier when requestType is VIP.

payerPhone.description: Payer's KBZPay or WavePay phone number.

receiptImageBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG receipt screenshot encoded as Base64.

adminNote.description: Optional review note added by Admin.

reviewedBy.description: Admin email that processed this request.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and update.

HelpMessage.title: HelpMessage
HelpMessage.description: Support message sent by a creator to Admin with Admin reply thread.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and update.

/users/{userId}.description: Creator account profile storing trial dates, Video Coins balance, and VIP tier.

/users/{userId}/recapScripts/{scriptId}.description: Per-user private vault of saved Myanmar Movie Recap scripts.

/appConfig/{configId}.description: Global application settings document ('settings') managed by Admin.

/helpMessages/{messageId}.description: User help and support messages with Admin replies.
